notes: Read SKILL.md and references/waf-rules.md in full. The skill covers AWS WAF (CLI, managed rule groups, Terraform, ALB/API Gateway association), Cloudflare WAF rulesets via API and Terraform, ModSecurity with Nginx plus the OWASP Core Rule Set, custom rules, and a read-only log-analysis tuning script.

Medium: following it has the agent create and associate AWS WAF Web ACLs, POST rulesets to the Cloudflare API with a bearer token from ${CF_TOKEN}, apt-install ModSecurity or build it from source, git-clone the CRS and write config files under /etc/nginx/modsec. Acceptable because adding a WAF is the user's stated goal, it strengthens rather than disables security controls, credentials come from user-supplied environment variables, and the guidance repeatedly says to start in detection mode and tune before blocking (SKILL.md:367, 498, 508).

Review before applying: the sample main.conf sets `SecRuleEngine On` immediately despite the DetectionOnly comment (SKILL.md:367-368); the optional source build clones ModSecurity and the CRS without a pinned tag (SKILL.md:331-334, 396); geo-block country lists (SKILL.md:119, references/waf-rules.md:79) are examples to adapt. Related Skills (SKILL.md:521-523) link to sibling skills ../../scanning/dast-scanning/, ../ssl-tls-management/, ../firewall-config/ as optional reading only.
